bet_suggestion.after_deposit: After you deposit there is nothing to copy or configure. The Aero app stakes the bet in the pool's gauge (its default, rewards=aero), and NockNock reads that gauge for your wallet's stakes at the start of every cycle (CHECK NOW runs one at once). A bet your wallet deposited itself into this pool is tracked by itself; anything else it finds staked there waits for one tap.
assumptions: Both sides are valued at the pool's price: WETH at this cycle's ETH/USD, NOCK at the pool's own NOCK per WETH.
The amounts are exact for the pool's price this cycle; the app recomputes the other side from whichever amount is typed.
Staked in the gauge, a bet earns AERO instead of swap fees: it has no LP-claimable fee figure.
A bet that leaves its range holds one token only and earns nothing more; it counts as cashed out and does not stop a new one.
The outcomes hold ETH/USD constant: a NOCK/USD move is the same NOCK/ETH move.
